env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# An optional function type in parentheses loses its grouping
# parentheses together when a block comment sits inside them or between
# them and the question mark. The module runs natively, ejects, and the
# ejected module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from
# $UPROOT1272 and prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^62 11 5 -1$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/optionparen

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func callOpt(f (func(int) int /* inner */) /* outer */?, n int) int {
	if f != nil {
		return f(n)
	}
	return -1
}

func main() {
	var a (func(int) int /* inner */)? = func(n int) int { return (61 + n) }
	var b ((func(int) int /* inner */) /* outer */)? = func(n int) int { return (n + 1) }
	var c ( /* lead */ func(int) int)? = func(n int) int { return n }
	var d (func(int) int)?
	fmt.Println(callOpt(a, 1), callOpt(b, 10), callOpt(c, 5), callOpt(d, 1))
}
